content_fields.title: Limit network access by blocking connections from unknown IP addresses (PostgreSQL)
content_fields.description: Restrict which network sources may connect to PostgreSQL.
content_fields.guidance: Host-based access rules should permit connections only from the application's address range, with everything else rejected, reinforced by network-level filtering.
content_fields.found: The database is reachable from any container on the shared default network; access rules live in pg_hba.conf, which is not in the repository.
content_fields.missing: pg_hba.conf and the network policy configuration.
content_fields.conclusion: Source restriction is database server and network configuration applied outside this repository.
content_fields.action: The database administration team should tighten pg_hba.conf and the surrounding network rules.
